witness: Imagination.exe (PE32 x86, MSVC) sub_401290, vendored as decompiler/crates/kuna-analysis/tests/fixtures/stdcallpop_pe_i386.exe
decisions: Hypothesis H1 ('possibly incorrect x86 Windows callee stack-cleanup tracking') is UPHELD and now located exactly: StackSolver::build (coreaction.cc:238) contributes the guessed equation `extrapop = 4` for every call whose model carries extrapop=unknown, which is every call under x86win.cspec's __stdcall default. Measured drift on the witness: hFile off by 8 (LocalAlloc's 2 args), the ReadFile buffer/count off by 24 (LocalAlloc+SetFilePointer), the checksum load off by 44 (+ReadFile+GetLastError) -- exactly the cumulative unpopped argument bytes.

The captain's refutation note is confirmed and its acceptance trap avoided: the promoted probe additionally requires the wsprintfA checksum operand to be the same vN the ReadFile lpBuffer points at, so a cosmetic rename cannot pass.

The second, independent defect the captain recorded (sub_401290 declared void, hFile modelled as an uninitialised local) is ALSO closed by the same change: with the frame correct the read at ESP+0x1c lands at entry+4 and recovers as a parameter.

The guess is restricted to IMPORTED callees (Varnode::externref over the IAT, painted by peimportcall). That is the ABI rule -- Win32 entry points are __stdcall -- and it is also what separates the wins from the losses in the measured sweep: every improved call was an import, and the first draft's three regressions were all internal MSVC __cdecl helpers.

The __cdecl varargs imports (wsprintfA) are separated by a caller-cleanup test measured as the highest stack-pointer value reachable from the call, not by looking for an `add esp,#k` op: the additive normalization re-bases the following push run onto the call's own result and leaves the cleanup Varnode dead.

Residual, documented in the spec and the option's use_when: a correct frame is bigger, so on deep-frame MSVC CRT helpers (sub_40264d, sub_40457e, sub_4047cd on the witness) an outgoing-argument slot now falls inside the caller's localrange and checkInputTrialUse scores it no-use, dropping arguments those functions previously recovered by accident of a wrong frame. The stack model there is provably right (the return-address push lands at exactly stack-0x1bc, the hand-traced truth); the loss is a separate argument-recovery weakness this exposes.
